
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
get_ps_assigned <- function(N=ps){
    read_csv("key_dates.csv") |> 
        filter(Item == "Homework", 
               Number == N, 
               str_detect(Details, "Released")) |>
        pull(Date) |>
        format("%A %B %d")
}

get_ps_due <- function(N=ps){
    read_csv("key_dates.csv") |> 
        filter(Item == "Homework", 
               Number == N, 
               str_detect(Details, "Due")) |>
        pull(Date) |>
        format("%A %B %d at 5:00PM on Canvas/Courseworks")
}
```

- Problem Set Assigned: `r get_ps_assigned(ps)`
- **Due Date: `r get_ps_due(ps)`**
